final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId AS raceId, r.name AS name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), name_avg AS (SELECT name, AVG(avg_points) AS name_avg_points FROM per_race GROUP BY name) SELECT p.raceId, p.name, p.avg_points, p.cnt, p.avg_points / n.name_avg_points AS ratio FROM per_race p JOIN name_avg n ON n.name = p.name ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
